reason: The reported negative effect (-2.14) exists only when the control mgmt_rating_2023 is included. That variable is measured in 2023, after training, and correlates 0.54 with training, so it is a post-treatment collider or mediator. Without it, and with only pre-period controls, the training coefficient is positive (about +0.5, p<0.05), and the raw estimate is about +2.2 to +2.5. The negative conclusion is an artifact of bad-control bias, and the report tried only one specification.
